quoted.text:
THE BORING COMPANY HQ: Bastrop, Texas, October

Here is my flyover of TBC's Bastrop headquarters and Prufrock factory. It's is where they test every machine before it ships, build and store equipment, precast tunnel segments, liner trucks, vertical cassettes and conveyor belt systems, and more. They house their Prufrock Command Center here to control all the Prufrock's soon to be around the world.

- The SpaceX Pedestrian Tunnel started as Porpoise Test 6 (PT6). TBC first bored it to test (no people in the tunnel) ZPIT continuous mining, an upgraded liner truck and the "SNAILS on RAILS" navigation system. After the test, they turned it into a 500 ft walkway under FM1209 that connects the SpaceX site to Hyperloop Plaza, where The Boring Bodega is. People use it so they don't have to cross that busy road on foot.
 
- Hard-rock Prufrock-MB4 being constructed for Nashville's Music City LOOP.

- The Test Tunnel PT5 connects SpaceX's Starlink factory to TBC under FM1209. It was the first use of custom hexagonal segments, automated gantry steering, quick craneless retrieval, and the first version of ZPIT. It's now a test bench for liner trucks, vertical cassettes and new belt systems.

- Hyperloop Test Tunnel was PT4; the first craneless, pitless retrieval of the machine. It's now a vacuum tunnel for Hyperloop vacuum pump system testing. It also connects SpaceX's Starlink factory to TBC under FM1209.

- Lastly, Prufrock-5 after completing a test tunnel connecting Ring Ranch and possibly the SpaceX Starmind Factory. I videoed it right before it was loaded up and shipped to San Antonio, Texas, for the Morgan's Wonderland Tunnel.

If you have any questions, leave them in the comments. Subscriber Photo-thread and Support links in the thread.

Thanks for watching!
quoted.text_zh:
无聊公司总部：德克萨斯州巴斯特罗普，十月

这是我飞越过的 TBC 巴斯特罗普总部和普鲁弗洛克工厂。他们在这里对每台机器进行装运前测试、建造和存储设备、预制隧道管段、班轮卡车、垂直输送带和传送带系统等。他们将普鲁弗洛克指挥中心设在这里，以控制即将遍布世界各地的所有普鲁弗洛克指挥中心。

- SpaceX 人行隧道最初名为 Porpoise Test 6 (PT6)。 TBC 首先对其进行钻孔以测试（隧道中无人）ZPIT 连续采矿、升级的班轮卡车和“RAILS 上的 SNAILS”导航系统。测试结束后，他们将其改造成 FM1209 下的一条 500 英尺长的走道，将 SpaceX 站点与 The Boring Bodega 所在的 Hyperloop Plaza 相连。人们使用它，这样他们就不必步行穿过那条繁忙的道路。
 
- 为纳什维尔音乐城 LOOP 建造的硬摇滚 Prufrock-MB4。

- 测试隧道 PT5 将 SpaceX 的 Starlink 工厂连接到 FM1209 下的 TBC。这是首次使用定制六边形段、自动龙门转向、快速无起重机检索以及 ZPIT 的第一个版本。它现在是班轮卡车、垂直盒式磁带和新型皮带系统的测试台。

- 超级高铁测试隧道为 PT4；首次无起重机、无坑地回收机器。它现在是用于超级高铁真空泵系统测试的真空隧道。它还通过 FM1209 将 SpaceX 的 Starlink 工厂连接到 TBC。

- 最后，Prufrock-5 在完成连接 Ring Ranch 和可能的 SpaceX Starmind Factory 的测试隧道后。我在它被装载并运往德克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市摩根仙境隧道之前拍摄了视频。

如果您有任何疑问，请在评论中留下。订阅者照片线程和线程中的支持链接。

感谢您的观看！

SPACEX: The Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) tested Rocket Cargo point-to-point delivery on the October 20th Bandwagon-5 launch via SpaceX’s Starfall reentry capsule. 

AFRL agile cargo pods inside the capsule carried a SATCOM-enabled tracker, batteries, a reverse osmosis desalinator, survival gear, and emergency medical equipment, with sensors measuring temperature, shock, and vibration during launch and reentry. 

Engineers also fit-checked a UNI-PAC III life raft for possible future use. The test evaluates whether commercial rockets can rapidly deliver critical supplies worldwide to sites without roads or runways, supporting future military resupply, rescue operations, and disaster relief.

Per Brig. Gen. Douglas P. Wickert, AFRL commander and Department of the Air Force Technology Executive Officer, "Today’s launch was another demonstration of how AFRL is partnering with industry to burn down risk, collect hard data and deliver war-winning technologies for the operational force."

Per Adam Remaly, Director of AFRL Technology Transition Office, "This was a critical achievement to demonstrate the potential of Rocket Cargo delivery for point-to-point rapid global mobility for the Future Force."

More SpaceX news in today's EC below!






S.E. Robinson, Jr. (@SERobinsonJr)

SPACEX：空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 在 10 月 20 日通过 SpaceX 的 Starfall 再入舱发射 Bandwagon-5 时测试了火箭货物点对点交付。 

太空舱内的 AFRL 敏捷货舱携带有卫星通信跟踪器、电池、反渗透海水淡化器、救生装备和紧急医疗设备，传感器在发射和重返大气层期间测量温度、冲击和振动。 

工程师还对 UNI-PAC III 救生筏进行了安装检查，以备将来使用。该测试评估商用火箭是否能够在全球范围内向没有道路或跑道的地点快速运送关键物资，支持未来的军事补给、救援行动和救灾。

每准将。 AFRL 指挥官兼空军技术部执行官道格拉斯·P·威克特 (Douglas P. Wickert) 将军表示：“今天的发布再次展示了 AFRL 如何与工业界合作，降低风险、收集硬数据并为作战部队提供制胜技术。”

AFRL 技术转型办公室主任 Adam Remaly 表示：“这是一项关键成就，展示了火箭货物运输对于未来部队点对点快速全球机动性的潜力。”

SPACEX: The University of Louisiana Board today approved a lease that brings SpaceX to the Peter M. John and David M. John Wildlife and Coastal Preservation Center in Vermilion Parish; the old Pecan Island school. 

UL Lafayette will lease the school building and about 5 acres to Ragin’ Cajun Facilities, Inc., a UL-affiliated nonprofit, for $1 per year for 40 years. That nonprofit will sublease the property to SpaceX for the same term, with property improvements in lieu of cash rent. Exhibit A listing those improvements was blank in the board materials. 

Allowed uses include housing, warehousing, and fabrication. At the meeting, officials noted SpaceX wants immediate access ahead of a possible sale as soon as next year. 

The facility includes offices, an Olympic-sized pool, basketball court, tennis court, and track.

允许的用途包括住房、仓储和制造。在会议上，官员们指出 SpaceX 希望在最快明年出售之前立即获得许可。 

该设施包括办公室、奥林匹克规模的游泳池、篮球场、网球场和跑道。

TESLA: Fort Bend County, Texas, has now signed off on its local incentive package for Tesla’s proposed ~$10.1 billion Project Crystal Sun.
Combined with the earlier August reinvestment zone and the September unanimous Lamar CISD approval of the 10-year JETI school property tax limitation, the major local steps are complete.
Video

quoted.text:
TESLA: Today at 1 p.m. CT Fort Bend County commissioners will consider four agreements for Tesla’s proposed ~$10.1 billion vertically integrated solar cell and module manufacturing plant, Project Crystal Sun. 

The agreements cover:

- Property Tax Abatement Agreement between Fort Bend County and Tesla located in Precinct 2, Reinvestment Zone No. 34. in a Precinct 2 reinvestment zone.

- Chapter 381 Economic Development Agreement between Fort Bend County, Texas and Tesla to encourage investment and job creation in Fort Bend County.

- Foreign Trade Zone Site Non-Objection and Payment in Lieu of Certain Taxes Agreement between Fort Bend County, Fort Bend County Drainage District, and Tesla, and authorize the County Judge to execute the Non-Objection. Fort Bend County payments under this Agreement would be deposited into the County General Fund and Fort Bend County Drainage payments would be deposited into the Drainage District Operating Account.

- True Up Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreement between Fort Bend County and Tesla with all payments under this Agreement to be deposited into the County General Fund.

Lamar CISD already approved a related 10-year JETI school property tax limitation in September. The meeting was at 1 p.m. at the Fort Bend County Courthouse, 401 Jackson St., Richmond.

Live feed link in the thread.

特斯拉：今天下午 1 点康涅狄格州本德堡县委员将考虑与特斯拉拟建的价值约 101 亿美元的垂直一体化太阳能电池和组件制造厂 Project Crystal Sun 签订的四项协议。 

这些协议涵盖：

- 本德堡县与位于 2 区再投资区 34 号再投资区 2 区的特斯拉之间签订的财产税减免协议。

- 德克萨斯州本德堡县与特斯拉签订的第 381 章经济发展协议，旨在鼓励本德堡县的投资和创造就业机会。

- 本德堡县、本德堡县排水区和特斯拉之间的外贸区场地不反对和代替某些税收协议的付款，并授权县法官执行不反对。本德堡县根据本协议支付的款项将存入县普通基金，本德堡县排水付款将存入排水区运营账户。

- 本德堡县与 Tesla 之间的 True Up 付款代税 (PILOT) 协议，本协议项下的所有付款均将存入县普通基金。

Lamar CISD 已于 9 月份批准了相关的 10 年 JETI 学校财产税限制。会议于下午 1 点举行。位于里士满杰克逊街 401 号的本德堡县法院。

线程中的实时提要链接。

结合 8 月份早些时候的再投资区和 9 月份 Lamar CISD 一致批准的 10 年 JETI 学校财产税限制，当地的主要步骤已经完成。

TESLA: Ørsted announced that construction of its first large-scale battery energy storage system, named Iceni, is complete and the system has entered the testing phase. 

The 300 MW / 600 MWh system consists of 170 Tesla Megapack 2XLs installed alongside the onshore converter station for the 2.9 GW Hornsea 3 Offshore Wind Farm near Norfolk, UK. 

Capacity is equivalent to the daily electricity use of about 80,000 UK homes. The project, delivered with Hitachi Energy, Knights Brown, and Tesla, shares a National Grid connection point with Hornsea 3—one of the first large-scale co-located setups of this type.

More Tesla news in today's EC below!

TESLA: Bulgaria’s Ministry of Energy announced the groundbreaking of the Battery Park – Tvarditsa in southeastern Bulgaria. 

Energy Minister Iva Petrova and Prime Minister Rumen Radev attended. 

The project is a 300 MWh system with up to 5 hours of storage duration, using 80 Megapack 2XLs. It is the first of three investments in a program worth over €350 million with a combined planned capacity exceeding 2,300 MWh, developed in partnership with Asarel-Trade, Power Profit, and Tesla. Commissioning is targeted for the second quarter of 2027.

Per Minister Petrova, "We will make every effort to maintain our strategic advantage through an adequate regulatory framework that supports investments in storage, batteries, PSHPPs and new energy capacities."

TERAFAB: According to reports, Tesla and SpaceX are in talks with 10 South Korean semiconductor suppliers with half already under NDAs. 

Discussions have covered materials, process equipment, piping and valves, testing components, cleaning services, and related items. 

At SEMICON West in San Francisco, Terafab representatives visited booths of companies including ENF Technology, Dongjin Semichem, Asflow, BMT, GnG Intech, Unisem, MiCo, and Hanmi Semiconductor. 

Most firms are existing Tesla or SpaceX suppliers; former Intel and GlobalFoundries personnel have also helped bring in contacts. 

Global equipment makers such as Lam Research and Applied Materials are also understood to have dedicated Terafab teams, and Fujifilm has held regular meetings on CMP slurries and other chemicals.
